title: Hai momino pe farz
body:
hai momino pe farz ita'at hussain ki
<<DIVIDER>>
karboabala mein zulm o jafa ka riwaj tha
sar pe yazeediyat ke khilafat ka taaj tha
shabbir ka lahoo jo maseeha mizaaj tha
warna munafiqat ka maraz la-ilaaj tha
yun karbala mein fikr o nazar ki dawa hui
karbobala ki khaak bhi khaake shifa hui
hai momino pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
aaye hai deen e haq ke liye karbala hussain
sibte rasool o laqte dil e murtuza hussain
hadi imam haq ke wali rehnuma hussain
tum ko pukarte hai azadaar ya hussain
aankhon mein apni ashke aza leke aaye hai
dil mein shaoor e karbobala leke aaye hai
hai momino pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
yun karbala mein sheh ne bhara ghar luta diya
khud sogaye to deen ka muqaddar jaga diya
chehre se ahle kufr ke parda hata diya
asghar ne has ke saare jahan ko rula diya
baysheer mein asar tha ali ke shaoor ka
asghar ke has ke tod diya buth ghuroor ka
hai momino pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
bedi pehen ke abid e bemaar aayega
is raaste mein shaam ka bazaar aayega
ye zikr baad sayyede abraar aayega
jab tasht mein ye sar sar e darbar aayega
zindan mein shor hoga zameen thar tharayegi
baba ka naam leke sakina bulayegi
hai momino pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
hogi abhi to shaam e ghariban ki daastan
cheenga shimr baali sakina ki baaliyan
bazaar e shaam pahunchega lut kar ye karwan
qaidi banegi ahmed e mursal ki betiyan
baaqi musibatein hai abhi qaid khane ki
in qaidiyon pe hongi nigahein zamane ki
hai momino pe farz...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehra ka laal sibte rasool e anaam hai
khanjar talay bhi bakshishe ummat se kaam hai
shabbir ka payaam khuda ka payaam hai
matloob e do jahan shahe aali maqam hai
paata raha urooj yuhin gham hussain ka
lehra raha hai aaj bhi parcham hussain ka
hai momino pe farz...
author: Urooj Bijnori
